name: Computational brutalism
summary: A retro-futurist instrument register with its structure on show: drafting-film grey over a plotting grid with major lines every five cells, monospaced text and mono headings at real size, square corners, heavy 3 px section rules and 2 px compartments with inverse header bars, coordinate-marked sections, uppercase measurement labels and one hazard-orange signal; in dark mode the same build reads as a phosphor CRT with an amber signal. Flat: no blur, no soft elevation.
use_when: opt-in only: the brief names brutalist, brutalism, computational, retro-futurist, CRT, terminal or telemetry, or the Korean 브루탈리즘, 레트로퓨처 or 터미널 감성
developer tools, consoles, data instruments, research or engineering products that want a raw, mechanical, high-density voice
a launch page for a technical product that should read as a spec sheet rather than a brochure
avoid_when: the brief asks for warmth, softness, play or a consumer-friendly tone
long-form reading for a general audience (monospaced body text slows it down)
the brief says neo-brutalism or neo-brutalist (that is the neo-brutalism style)
signature: an exposed plotting grid: a faint 32 px grid with a stronger line every 160 px, and blocks that sit on it
mono type at real scale: body, headings, figures and the signature moment in JetBrains Mono, the display title in heavy uppercase Pretendard
raw structure on purpose: 3 px section rules, 2 px compartments in line-strong, panel heads as inverse ink bars, square corners everywhere (status dots stay round)

measurement and index labels: every section carries a data-coord label on its rule (sheet, grid reference, revision), ui-coord and ui-ruler name real sizes and positions, ui-frame adds registration crosses
uppercase mono meta: labels, table heads, nav groups, tags and legends in capitals with 0.08 em tracking

a strong signal colour plus a plotter-blue second accent: hazard orange in light, amber phosphor in dark, on the primary action and the figure that matters; plotter blue on the second series and featured compartments; phosphor green as the support tint
terminal and CRT detail: a ui-prompt with a static block cursor, ui-scan scanlines on readouts (never over body text), stepped motion (steps(3, end))
forbid: rounded corners, pills and soft cards (DS-005 reports any radius off the lock)
blurred or soft drop shadows and offset shadows (DS-007: the lock declares flat elevation)
gradients other than the plotting grid, glassmorphism, glow and neon bloom (CF-404 and the slop register report them)
rainbow charts, more than four accent hue families in one view, or decorative emoji
scanlines or noise over body text; flicker, blinking cursors or animated scan effects
decorative fake data: every coordinate, revision, grid reference or unit id must label something on the page
hiding the structure: borderless floating cards, centred hero text over empty space
